caption:
Stop eyeballing flour, it's wrecking your baking.

Scooping flour straight into a measuring cup packs it down differently every time. The same recipe comes out dense one day and dry the next, and it's rarely the recipe's fault.

This digital kitchen scale has a tare button that zeros out the bowl and an LCD that switches between units, and it's sitting at 4.7 stars across more than 120,000 reviews.

Weigh ingredients the way the recipe actually meant, for about $11.
